imagem: A small theater at night with red velvet curtains and a warm spotlight on the stage. On stage, an exaggerated cartoon villain with a black top hat, curly mustache and long black cape spreads his arms dramatically. In the foreground, seen from behind and in profile, the young woman sits in the audience holding a striped popcorn bucket, watching amused.
movimento: The cartoon villain on stage swirls his cape, twirls his mustache and makes big theatrical threatening gestures. The woman in the audience eats popcorn calmly and smiles, unimpressed. The spotlight flickers softly. Static camera.

imagem: A cozy kitchen at golden hour. The young man, smiling gently, offers the young woman a small bouquet of orange flowers with both hands. She receives it with a soft surprised smile. Warm sunset light through the window, potted plants.
movimento: The man gently hands the small bouquet to the woman with a kind smile; she takes it, smells the flowers and smiles shyly. Warm sunlight shifts softly, a curtain moves in the breeze. Slow camera push-in.

imagem: The young woman stands in a dreamy starry indigo space holding a large magnifying glass. Floating in an arc around her are seven glowing round medallions with simple symbols: a heart, a question mark, an anchor, a cloud, a triangle, a flag and a speech bubble. Soft golden glow, sparkles.
movimento: The woman slowly moves the magnifying glass from one glowing medallion to the next, curious and focused; the seven medallions float gently and pulse with soft light, stars twinkle. Static camera.

imagem: A cozy café table. The young woman holds a small paper label sticker in her fingers, about to stick it on the back of her friend, a cheerful young woman with long wavy red hair and a green cardigan who is looking away and laughing. The young woman hesitates with a thoughtful doubtful expression.
movimento: The woman raises the paper label toward her friend's back, then hesitates, thinks, and slowly lowers her hand and crumples the label, deciding not to use it. The friend keeps laughing, unaware. Static camera.

imagem: The same café table. The friend with long wavy red hair and green cardigan has just spilled her coffee on the table and laughs apologetically, embarrassed, while the young woman smiles kindly and hands her napkins.
movimento: The friend laughs, embarrassed, wiping the spilled coffee; the woman smiles warmly and helps with napkins; both laugh together. Static camera.

imagem: The young woman stands next to a cork board on a living room wall covered with pinned photos and small notes connected by red threads. A glowing light bulb appears above her head as she points at the board with an excited 'aha' expression.
movimento: The woman points along the board as the threads between the pinned photos light up one by one with a warm golden glow, forming a clear pattern; the light bulb above her head glows brighter and she smiles. Slow camera push-in.

imagem: A soft cream parchment banner with wavy edges floating in a dreamy starry indigo night sky above pink and orange clouds; a small glowing brass lantern hangs at the top left corner of the banner. The banner is blank and empty in the middle, ready for a title. Twinkling stars.

Split vertical composition: at the top, the young man on his sofa typing on his phone with a big smile; at the bottom, the young woman on her bed holding her phone, surprised and flattered. Many pink heart icons and white message bubbles fly between their phones.
movimento: Dozens of pink hearts and white message bubbles stream nonstop from the man's phone down to the woman's phone; he types faster and grins, her eyes widen and she blushes, overwhelmed. Static camera.

imagem: A romantic rooftop at night over a city with fireworks in the sky, some forming heart shapes. The young man presents a huge bouquet of red roses to the young woman, who looks dazzled but slightly uneasy.
movimento: Fireworks burst in pink and gold, some forming hearts; the man offers the giant bouquet with a charming smile; the woman takes it, dazzled, then her smile fades into a hint of doubt. Rose petals drift in the air. Slow camera push-in.

imagem: Close-up of a smartphone lying on a wooden table next to a coffee mug, with a tall tower of pink hearts bursting out of its glowing screen. Warm cozy evening light.
movimento: Pink hearts keep shooting out of the phone screen like a fountain, piling into a tall wobbling tower; steam rises from the mug. Static camera.

imagem: The young woman sits at a wooden desk in a cozy university library at night, reading a big open book with charts and notes, a warm desk lamp beside her and tall bookshelves behind.
movimento: The woman turns the pages of the book with interest, stops on a page with charts and takes notes, nodding slowly; the desk lamp glows warmly. Very slow camera push-in.

imagem: A classic university campus building with brick walls and arched windows at dusk, many small students with backpacks walking on the paths and lawn, purple and orange sky.
movimento: Students walk along the campus paths, chat and carry books; leaves drift, windows light up one by one as dusk falls. Slow camera pan.

imagem: The young man stands proudly in front of a large mirror admiring himself with a smug smile, but his reflection shows a smaller, insecure version of him looking down sadly.
movimento: The man adjusts his collar and admires himself confidently, while his reflection in the mirror shrinks a little and looks down insecurely. Static camera.

imagem: The young woman stands thoughtfully with one hand on her chin; above her floats a glowing golden balance scale, perfectly level, in a calm purple room with soft lamp light.
Living room in the evening. The young woman calmly raises one open palm in a gentle 'no' gesture toward the young man, who stands in front of her.
movimento: The woman calmly raises her palm and says no with a gentle firm face; the man's charming smile slowly freezes and turns into a cold surprised stare. Static camera, subtle push-in.

imagem: A kitchen. The young man talks calmly with white speech bubbles around him, while the young woman holds her hand to her head, confused, with small question marks and scribbles floating around her head.
movimento: The man talks calmly as white speech bubbles pop up one after another; the woman rubs her head, more and more confused, as question marks spin around her. Static camera.

imagem: At night in her bedroom, the young woman sits on the bed anxiously scrolling through screenshots on her phone; floating translucent screenshot cards hover around her.
movimento: The woman scrolls quickly through screenshots, comparing them; floating screenshot cards drift around her and flip; she looks tired and anxious. Static camera.

imagem: The young woman stands in front of a bathroom mirror, rehearsing what she will say, with a worried face and hand gestures; her phone on the sink shows a chat with a friend.
movimento: The woman rehearses a conversation in front of the mirror, gesturing and mouthing words, stops, sighs, and starts again, then picks up the phone to text a friend. Static camera.

imagem: A 1930s-style theater stage set as a Victorian living room with red velvet curtains and glowing gas lamps on the walls. A man in a dark three-piece suit talks persuasively to his wife in a long mustard dress, who holds her head, doubtful.
movimento: The gas lamps on the walls slowly dim and flicker; the husband speaks calmly and persuasively; the wife looks at the lamps, then at him, confused and doubting herself. Static camera.

imagem: An old movie theater seen from the back rows: silhouettes of an audience in red seats watching a big glowing screen that shows a vintage scene of a man and a woman in a Victorian parlor with gas lamps. Warm projector light beam.
The young woman researcher sits at a desk with a laptop at night by a window with city lights; above her float glowing icons of a light bulb, a balance scale and a speech bubble.
movimento: The woman types and reads on the laptop, then leans back thinking with her hand on her chin; the floating icons pulse gently above her. Static camera.

imagem: A park playground at dusk with a seesaw: the young man sits on the low side, heavy and relaxed, while the young woman is stuck high up on the other side, holding on nervously.
movimento: The man sits heavily and relaxed, keeping the seesaw down; the woman, stuck up high, kicks her legs and tries to push it down without success. Leaves drift. Static camera.

imagem: The young woman looks small and uncertain in the center while big shadowy pointing fingers surround her from the edges and soft grey labels float around her head, in a dim purple room.
A living room where the walls bend and ripple, picture frames melt and the floor looks like water reflecting the room. The young woman stands in the middle with her hand on her head, disoriented.
movimento: The walls ripple and wave slowly, the picture frames drip and stretch, the floor ripples like water; the woman turns her head, disoriented. Static camera.

imagem: The young woman steps out of a doorway into a long hallway full of soft fog, looking back over her shoulder, lost and unsure.
movimento: The woman walks slowly into the foggy hallway, looks back over her shoulder with a lost face, as the fog thickens around her. Slow camera follow.

imagem: The young woman sits alone on the floor of an empty room hugging her knees, a heavy grey storm cloud hovering right above her head; no one else is there.
movimento: The grey cloud slowly grows darker and heavier above the woman, a few drops fall; she hugs her knees tighter, looking guilty, though the room is empty. Static camera, slow push-in.
